description: Best DeFi yields (APY) on a given blockchain, across all protocols and tokens, highest first, source DefiLlama — for an agent asking 'where's the best yield on Base/Ethereum/Arbitrum/...?'. Parameter: ?chain=<slug> (e.g. base, required). Optional: ?limit=<n> (1-100, default 10). Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC).

chain.description: DefiLlama chain slug/name (e.g. base, ethereum, arbitrum).

limit.description: Number of pools to return (1-100, default 10).

name: get_api_defi_yields_by_chain
